defaultStyle: Top-down 2D arcade racing game sprite viewed from directly overhead (bird's-eye view, 90 degrees), clean vector-style illustration with subtle shading, transparent background, single object only, centered composition, no text, no UI, no drop shadow, consistent lighting across all assets, 256x256 target size

assets.name: Player Car
assets.description: A sleek sports car viewed from directly overhead, nose pointing up, bright blue body with a single white racing stripe down the center, visible windshield and roof, two clearly defined front and rear wheel pairs, clearly the hero car

assets.name: Red Opponent
assets.description: An aggressive muscle car viewed from directly overhead, nose pointing up, bright red body with wide black hood stripes, wider and chunkier than the player car

assets.name: Green Opponent
assets.description: A compact rally car viewed from directly overhead, nose pointing up, lime green body with matte-black racing number panel on the roof, similar size to the player car

assets.name: Yellow Opponent
assets.description: A long low supercar viewed from directly overhead, nose pointing up, bright canary yellow body with black side-skirts and rear spoiler, noticeably longer than the player car

assets.name: Road Straight
assets.description: A seamlessly tileable vertical road tile viewed from directly overhead, dark asphalt grey with a single dashed yellow line down the center and solid white edge lines on both sides, designed to tile edge-to-edge vertically, NOT transparent

assets.name: Road Curve
assets.description: A 90-degree corner road tile viewed from directly overhead, dark asphalt grey turning from bottom-entry to right-exit, curved dashed yellow line and solid white edge lines, grass visible in the inner and outer corners, NOT transparent

assets.name: Traffic Cone
assets.description: A single orange-and-white striped traffic cone viewed from directly overhead, small circular footprint with the tip of the cone pointing up at the camera, clearly a small obstacle

assets.name: Oil Barrel
assets.description: A standard 55-gallon rusty oil barrel viewed from directly overhead, showing the circular top with the rim and a small cap, red-brown rusty colors, clearly a heavy obstacle

assets.name: Nitro Boost
assets.description: A small glowing orange lightning-bolt icon inside a soft circular halo, clearly a speed-boost pickup, viewed from overhead

assets.name: Shield Pickup
assets.description: A small glowing blue shield icon inside a soft circular halo, clearly a defensive pickup, viewed from overhead

assets.name: Finish Line
assets.description: A horizontally tileable black-and-white checkered finish-line strip spanning the width of the road, clearly a finish banner, NOT transparent, designed to tile horizontally
